title: Ines and the Kitchen
author: Paloma Thackeray
blurb: Ada Fairweather, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
